args.title: Document accepted amount formats for upload in API docs
args.body:
File: docs/API.md

Add a paragraph to the Uploads section of the API reference documenting the accepted amount formats for upload. Specify that amounts may use a dot for decimals and commas between thousands, a leading + or -, parentheses for a negative amount, and a leading €, $, £ or ¥. This clarifies what formats are accepted during upload as determined by testing, improving API documentation completeness.
